_purpose: Copy this file to ~/.remember/config.json to enable external storage mode.
_notes: Settings here override the plugin-shipped defaults for ALL your projects.
Layered merge order (highest priority wins): per-project > user-global > plugin defaults.

{slug} names the per-project directory, so a caller in another language cannot name it from this template alone. Session start therefore writes an index of project_dir -> slug at the store root — here, ~/.remember/tmp/sessions. See README, 'Computing the slug outside bash'.
